description: F1 vectors for extras.atrium.behavior (scripting-4b-2). Read by the client copy (packages/behaviors/src/behavior-spec.js) and by the server copy (packages/server/src/send-policy.js), so the two cannot drift. `ownId` is the behaviour node's own object id; every accepted value must pass the rule AND validateInteractivityGraph, and every refused value must return the named code. scripting-4c AC2 adds `listensForSelect` (a stored leaf, and whether a click on it is something this world listens for) and `withinActivateDistance` (the 10 m rule); both copies of each rule read these two arrays.

accepted.name: template: select-animation on its own node
template: select-visibility on its own node

refused.name: the value is not an object
nodeMap[0] is not the own id
targets entry is not an object id
an animation op with an empty table
animations loop is not a boolean
an animation index past the table
an animation reference that is not a literal
a bare event/onSelect, without its extension
event/onSelect configured on another node index
an event id outside the three
an event entry that carries values
a node whose declaration index is out of range
a back edge (a flow to an earlier node)
the graph is not an object
template params with an extra key
a template target that is not an object id
a template action outside its enum
template params seconds that are not an integer

listensForSelect.name: a declaration with no node using it
